entities.name: Abu al-Abbas al-Nabati
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Mufarraj bin Ani al-Khalil, better known as Abu al-Abbas al-Nabati, Ibn al-Rumiya or al-Ashshab,, was an Arab scientist, botanist, pharmacist and theologian from al-Andalus. He was a teacher of fellow Andalusian botanist Ibn al-Baitar.
